visualReview.notes: Inspected all 12 final portable views with sky reflections. The complete 120 m taper, original geological base islands, concentric grating, eight bollards and densely perforated upper twelve metres are visible. The original 212 reusable perforation-row meshes retain exactly 11,884 physical openings through GPU instances; source bytes remain unchanged. Generic upward cameras crop the monument intentionally; the named whole elevation shows ground and tip together.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 12 final shared-material views, including the north-up geographic frame. Four canonical 256 px procedural graphs supply marble and ordinary, bead-blasted and polished stainless steel. Each graph is read once; unload disposes all model geometry. Reflection-enabled metal stays silver and reflective. No embedded images or reference photographs are redistributed. Flat terrain is a placement inspection surface, not a street survey.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 31 final browser frames with opt-in sky-PMREM reflections: noon and late light, economy and high settings, synthetic cottages, seven source detail cameras, four whole-height levels, separate district/street base views, close-up tip and all four transitions. Every level retains the full silhouette, surround and eight bollards. District has coarser but continuous base and taper; near polished marks and all 11,884 daylight tip marks remain visible. Skyline averages fine patterns. Earlier captures taken during a test rebuild were discarded; final captures follow completed stable derivatives. The reflection-enabled fixture resolves the black-metal appearance of the original direct-light-only fixture.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-Q1134365 OSM way96578181 supplies the actual closed monument ring centered at [-6.260254122,53.349801149]. Its smaller approximate 2.2 m ring and 121.2 m map height are used only for identity and center; published 3 m base and 120 m height control geometry. Heading0 maps native+X east,+Z south. The cone and concentric grating are axial; the reconstructed geological stencil and regularized bollards have no certified compass phase. This is an explicit medium-fi reconstruction limit, not an invented measured azimuth. Terrain contact uses host street elevation with no footprint replacement.

fidelityReview.notes: Primary AQUA fabricator, IMOA engineering article and official Failte Ireland tourism references support 120 m height, 3 m base, 15 cm tip, first10m partly polished artwork and exactly11,884 15mm holes in upper12m. The architect-credited IMOA base photograph was inspected for geological horizontal islands, concentric grating, stone surround and bollards; the AQUA whole-spire image was inspected for silhouette. Detailed source remains byte-identical. Browser close-up replaces through-cut tip holes with opaque daylight diffuser marks; street/district average subpixel holes. Base artwork is an original reconstruction, not an exact tracing; bollard phase, maintenance hatches, current paving, night beacon and wind animation are outside this static daylight scope.
